reviews.title: Ok in the beginning
reviews.text: I liked this app when I first got it but after using many of their meditations over and over again I feel they really don’t add new meditations often enough. It’s too repetitive for me now so I have moved on to another app.

reviews.title: Good but not optimised for the iPad.
reviews.text: I’m a lifetime purchaser having used the app for a long time but it’s frustrating that the app hasn’t been optimised for the iPad. What gives? Why? It can’t be that difficult?

reviews.title: Charged me £65 even though I cancelled
reviews.text: I cancelled my Balance Mind and Meditation subscription well before the renewal date, yet the app still charged me £64.99. That is unacceptable. I then tried to contact support to request a refund and could not find clear contact details or a working support route in the app. The billing process lacks transparency and the support experience is poor. I expect a refund for a charge taken after cancellation and a simple way to reach a real support team.

reviews.title: Vile service and scammy
reviews.text: They gave me a free year, so I signed up.  I don't recall it ever saying it was a free trial which now trying to tell me it was got no notification from Apple or this company that it was going to renew.  Used it twice didn't like it.  They refused to refund me "because I'm outside the refund window" but holding somebody hostage to a product. They didn't really want in the first place that you use some tactic to get them to sign up for a year ago, isn't exactly how you build Goodwill with customers or get people to recommend your app and on the contrary, I would warn anyone from doing business with the company like this.   Their customer service claims it was a one year free trial.   I do believe the App Store requires a company to notify someone of an upcoming renewal charge and they didn't do that.  Apple would've refunded me if it wasn't more than two months when I realized I've been charged because they can't do a refund for something two months old and it suggested I ask the developer to refund me. Who doesn't care about Customer because if they did, they wouldn't try to hold customers hostage they don't want their product.
